market.title: Kamala Harris — 2028 U.S. Presidential Election Winner
market.resolutionNote: Resolves to whoever is inaugurated President in January 2029, based on AP/Fox/NBC race calls. This tracks the general-election winner contract specifically -- Harris is also priced separately on a 'wins the Democratic nomination' market (Polymarket has that at about 8.9%), a different and easier bar than winning the presidency outright, which is what this page's odds (around 5%) actually track.

marketBrief.text: Two polls this week reset the 2028 Democratic primary narrative: Emerson's national survey (July 23) has Harris at just 8%, behind Buttigieg, Newsom, and a tied Ossoff/Ocasio-Cortez -- and a University of New Hampshire poll two days earlier showed Ocasio-Cortez surging to 22%, with Harris down to 5%, a 17-point gap. That's a sharp reversal from earlier in the year, when Democratic insiders called her the 'fairly obvious' frontrunner. This page tracks the general-election contract specifically, not the nomination -- Polymarket prices Harris winning the nomination at about 8.9%, a different and easier bar than winning the presidency outright, where she sits near 5% on both platforms.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
